title: Wine Fridge Compressor Short-Cycle
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kitchen:appliance appliance_type=wine_fridge
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count(eval(compressor_state="on")) as on_events, avg(run_min) as avg_run_min by appliance _time
| where on_events>4 AND avg_run_min<5
| sort - on_events
description: Uses Wine-fridge telemetry telemetry to monitor how often the compressor is short-cycling in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for cooling patterns that waste energy or shorten compressor life, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Wine-fridge telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how often the compressor is short-cycling so you can spot cooling patterns that waste energy or shorten compressor life before it becomes annoying.
